meta.dm: d_t = e_model^2 - e_M2^2; long-run variance with equal weights on autocovariances 1..h-1 (Diebold-Mariano 1995; Bartlett weights if not positive); Harvey-Leybourne-Newbold correction; Student t, T-1 df; two-sided. p_bartlett: same with a Newey-West (Bartlett) variance, as a sensitivity. Nested pairs (M0 and M1 in M2, M2 in M6): the DM reference distribution is not exact under recursive estimation; indicative only
meta.estimation: expanding-window OLS with intercept, at least 60 training months, one regression per horizon
